{{Quote|I won't deny that Kelrodo-Ai is proving a difficult target, but let's remember this: The Western Reaches Operation has restored security and the rule of law to eight sectors so far, with the successful liberation of 95 worlds.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shea Hublin]]|<ref name="TGOKA">{{InsiderCite|132|The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai (short story)}}</ref>}}
A '''force superiority''' or '''superiority force''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[systems admiral]]. It was comprised of three [[battle squadron]]s, and a [[light squadron]], for a total average of ninety [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including three [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. Force superiority formations were expected to perform space superiority missions which was defined as "the complete absence of hostile craft within the orbital space of controlled worlds, and no chronic enemy ship activity within the entire system." The Imperial Navy considered space superiority to be their primary mission.

==History==
The [[Western Reaches Superiority Force]] was an early forge of the Empire that [[Western Reaches Operation|hunted]] down numerous [[separatist holdouts]] within its namesake [[Western Reaches|region]].
